messages.subject: Use the captured link offsets
messages.body: The gateway report and the capture line up. The application’s offsets don’t. It started counting after the old decoder changed the buffer. I’m using the link offsets to compare with the sender’s ledger.

messages.subject: Legacy archive import review
messages.body:
I’ve signed off ingestion. The bridge desk is putting our two records into a batch with three other verified sources.

The legacy reader refused some identifiers. I have its import trace with the batch at bridge-14.
